# InterINNL

India and Netherlands tech bridge: AI, Rust, Python, open source, and water / climate demos.

- Hub home: https://interinnl.interchouette.net/
- AquaChain demo: https://interinnl.interchouette.net/aquachain/
- Agent Ops (Module 9, x402 USDC): https://interinnl.interchouette.net/aquachain/agent-ops
- Contact (AquaChain): https://interinnl.interchouette.net/aquachain/contact

## Agent gateway (Phase G0 / G1)

Humans use Keplr on Osmosis. Autonomous agents pay USDC via HTTP 402 (x402 on Base Sepolia) through the AquaChain agent gateway, which relays drone measurements to citizen-science-registry on osmo-test-5.

- Repo: https://github.com/InterINNL/Aquachain-agent-gateway
- Site module: https://interinnl.interchouette.net/aquachain/agent-ops
- Flow: agent POST /v1/measurements (402) -> x402 verify/settle -> Osmosis CosmWasm relay

## Browser agents (WebMCP)

Discovery card: https://interinnl.interchouette.net/.well-known/mcp.json

Tools are registered in the Angular app when a user or agent opens the site in a WebMCP-capable browser. No remote Streamable HTTP endpoint.

### Hub tools (interinnl.interchouette.net/)

- get_site_overview
- get_contact
- list_public_pages
- list_projects
- open_public_page

### AquaChain tools (interinnl.interchouette.net/aquachain/)

- get_aquachain_overview
- list_modules
- open_module
- get_contact
- get_site_discovery
- send_aquachain_contact (declarative form tool on the contact page)
